content.text:
`gdd/goal.md` is still the template, so before planning a sub-goal I need to decide the goal with you. The question tool is not available here, so I am asking in chat.

1. What are you trying to build or achieve? (one or two sentences)
2. Who will use it? (only you / your team / outside users)
3. What does success look like? (what would be different once it works)
4. Any constraints I should know about? (platform, existing systems, deadlines)
5. When they conflict, what matters more: speed or certainty?

I have not changed any files.
